clips.title: The story
paras: Above Whelgar's Excavation Site, Sarltooth's Talon marks the end of the raptor's attack. Ormer Ironbraid wants the claw as proof that the beast has been slain.

Ormer Ironbraid watched from the ridge as raptors overran Whelgar's Excavation Site and butchered the dwarven expedition. He could not stop the slaughter. One massive raptor, Sarltooth, seemed to Ormer the likely pack leader. Seeking vengeance for his fallen kin, Ormer demanded the beast's death and one of its talons as proof. The claw marks the end of Sarltooth's reign over the ancient dwarven ruins.
